disasters.summary: Super Typhoon Champi (Rosal) began on 14 October 2026. As of 25 October it was still ongoing. Heavy rain and strong winds hit Jeju from 23 October, with 341.5 mm recorded on Mount Halla. The storm has left the Philippine Area of Responsibility and was forecast to approach Kyushu, Japan, where it was expected to become extratropical. In Taiwan, one person died and 171 were injured as of 23 October, and about 1,300 people were evacuated.

disasters.summary: A magnitude 7.0 earthquake struck Baqen County, Nagqu City, Xizang (Tibet), China, on 22 October 2026 at 22:33 local time. As of 24 October, Nagqu municipal government reported 16 people killed and 76 injured. Rescue, resettlement and relocation were still underway. Local officials warned that cracked or leaning homes could collapse in aftershocks.

Aftershocks were still being recorded, and 327 schools were to reopen on 26 October.

disasters.summary: A drought in Sudan, which sources link to El Niño, is raising the risk of famine, according to reports from October 2026. Reuters reported on 23 October that farmers already affected by war have struggled to harvest, and hunger figures are expected to rise. The event began on 21 June 2026 and is ongoing. The research found no reports covering the other countries in the feed.

Drought conditions remained critical across most of the continent in late September 2026, according to a JRC analysis run on 19 October 2026. disasters.summary: Kanlaon Volcano on Negros Island, Philippines, erupted on 10 October 2026 in a moderately explosive eruption, followed by repeated ash emissions. Phivolcs kept Alert Level 2. The Office of Civil Defense reported about 24,000 families affected by ash emissions as of 12 October. A further eruption on 17 October sent ash southwest. The activity was ongoing as of 18 October 2026.

Headlines report a fresh eruption around 19 October, another minor eruption reported 22 October, and Alert Level 1 maintained. These headlines were not verified against official bulletins, and the current status is not confirmed.

disasters.summary: A flash flood on the Bhote Koshi river in Rasuwa District, Nepal, began on 26 August 2026 and swept through Rasuwa and nearby districts. Reports from 29 August gave 675 deaths in Nepal and about 2,400 missing, with 84,270 people affected across six districts. The IFRC launched a CHF 25 million appeal on 27 August. The response is still active, with water restoration work reported in late September and early October.

disasters.summary: Monsoon rains from 5 July 2026 caused floods and landslides in Bangladesh, most severely in Cox's Bazar district, where 69 of 71 unions were inundated. Nationally, at least 51 deaths were reported by 12 July. By 25 July, government reports said conditions were improving. The IFRC DREF operation runs to January 2027. No source found reports active flooding as of 24 October 2026.
